For a calendar year, the spring equinox on September 22/23 and the Sharad equinox on March 20/21 are neutral. The South Pole is in the center of the Southern Hemisphere. Temperatures in the Southern Hemisphere are similar to those in the Northern Hemisphere located between northern latitudes
